name: coordinator
description: Run many worker agents from one coordinator session: scaffolded rules, lane cards and briefs, spawn/retire/respawn workers in orca, tmux, Windows Terminal or by hand, a scheduler worker for heavy jobs, a question queue, status reports, token-economy reminders, and a usage watcher with a graceful pause and resume.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Comma-separated repo paths workers start in (relative to the project root). The first is the default for spawn.

backend.title: Worker terminal backend
backend.description: Where a worker starts: orca (Orca terminal tabs), tmux (windows of the current or a `coord` session), wt (Windows Terminal tabs), or manual (print the command to run).

shell.title: Worker shell
shell.description: How the worker's AGENT_BUS_ROLE is set before its command: auto (PowerShell on Windows, POSIX elsewhere), posix, powershell or cmd.

workerCommand.title: Worker command template
workerCommand.description: The command that starts a worker. Placeholders: {model}, {prompt}, {role}, {brief}, {repo}. Add flags such as a permission mode here.

workerPrompt.title: Worker prompt template
workerPrompt.description: The first prompt a worker gets. Placeholders: {role}, {brief}, {model}, {repo}.
workerPrompt.default: Read {brief} and execute it. Your role is {role}.

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: The model a worker runs on ({model} in the command template).

maxLanes.title: Max concurrent lanes
maxLanes.description: spawn refuses a new worker while this many lanes are live.

retireTokens.title: Retire at (context tokens)
retireTokens.description: A worker past this many context tokens is reminded to update its lane card and retire.

pauseWeeklyPercent.title: Graceful pause at weekly usage (%)
pauseWeeklyPercent.description: When the weekly usage window reaches this, the coordinator is alerted to run the graceful pause (every lane checkpoints its card and stops). Going over it while lanes finish is fine.

pauseSessionPercent.title: Pause at session usage (%)
pauseSessionPercent.description: When the 5-hour session window reaches this, every session is told to checkpoint and pause.

probeIntervals.title: Usage probe schedule
probeIntervals.description: weeklyPercent:minutes steps for the usage watcher: the default probes every 60 min, every 20 from 70%, every 10 from 78%.

probeCommand.title: Usage probe command
probeCommand.description: The throwaway Claude Code session the watcher opens to read /usage (orca and tmux backends). Use a cheap model.

pauseReminderMin.title: Pause: reminder after (minutes)
pauseReminderMin.description: A lane that has not checkpointed this long after the pause request gets one reminder.

pauseGraceMin.title: Pause: interrupt after (minutes)
pauseGraceMin.description: A lane still silent this long after the pause request is interrupted and its terminal closed; its card is what it last wrote.

busDir.title: Bus directory
busDir.description: The agent-bus directory (used when the agent-bus plugin is installed).

trackerDb.title: Task tracker database
trackerDb.description: The task-tracker SQLite db; lanes show their in-progress tasks from it when it exists.

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: The short rules-core file every worker reads first.

briefsDir.title: Briefs directory
briefsDir.description: Where briefs, the resume brief, the scheduler brief and the handoff protocol live.

cardsDir.title: Lane cards directory
cardsDir.description: Where lane cards (one per role, the handoff) and lanes.json live.

reportsDir.title: Reports directory
reportsDir.description: Progress logs, the question queue, and the fallback for messages without the bus.

minFreeRamGb.title: Preflight: min free RAM (GB)
minFreeRamGb.description: preflight answers WAIT below this much free memory.

minBattery.title: Preflight: min battery (%)
minBattery.description: preflight answers WAIT below this battery level when not charging.

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python interpreter that runs the coordinator CLI (3.9 or newer).
